title: Billing Rights Figures for Northgate Card Accounts — Notice, Acknowledgment and Resolution Timeframes
content:
The billing-rights timeframes and dispute terms of each **Northgate Card Credit Accounts (issued by Harbor Point Bank, N.A.)** card are set out below.

| Card | Calendar days after the statement on which the disputed transaction first appeared within which a billing-error notice must be received | Calendar days after the transaction date within which a dispute on a non-Northgate Mastercard purchase can still be raised with the network | Provisional credit for the disputed amount posted when a dispute is opened |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Secured Card | 60 | not applicable | no |
| Northgate Store Card | 60 | not applicable | no |
| Northgate Mastercard | 60 | 120 | yes |
| Northgate World Mastercard | 60 | 120 | yes |
| Northgate Business Store Card | 60 | not applicable | no |
| Northgate Business Mastercard | 60 | 120 | yes |

| Term | Every Northgate Card |
|---|---|
| Calendar days after receiving a billing-error notice within which the issuer acknowledges it | 30 |
| Maximum complete billing cycles to resolve a billing-error dispute (never more than 90 days) | 2 |
| Maximum calendar days to resolve a billing-error dispute | 90 |
| A not-as-described or returned-not-credited dispute requires a prior good-faith attempt to resolve it with the merchant | yes |
| Cardholder liability for unauthorized use | 0.00 USD |

**Points of reading.** The network window of 120 days exists only on the three Mastercard cards, which are also the only cards that post a provisional credit when a dispute is opened. The closed-loop cards — the Northgate Secured Card, the Northgate Store Card and the Northgate Business Store Card — post no provisional dispute credit. A dispute is resolved within 2 complete billing cycles and never more than 90 days.
